portion_doctrine: Adobe Photoshop/Lightroom tutorial transcripts focusing on advanced editing techniques, layer management, AI-assisted design, and composite workflows. Content is instructional video transcripts with heavy boilerplate (timestamps, music cues, applause markers) interspersed with actionable techniques.
real_content_summary: This segment block contains tutorial transcripts from Terry White (Adobe Photoshop/Lightroom creator) and Brendan Williams covering Photoshop 27.6 release features (Firefly 5, rotate object, general distraction removal, layer cleanup AI, dynamic text shapes, reflection removal), comprehensive layer mastery curriculum (7 layer types, blending modes, smart objects, adjustment layers, layer masks, opacity), and advanced photo composite workflows including color grading, blending mode application, smart filters, and environmental storytelling in poster design. Boilerplate: music cues, timestamps, applause, UI navigation cues, resource links.
operating_rules: Layer-first workflow: Always use layers for non-destructive editing; never edit background layer directly
Smart object conversion: Convert all imported images to smart objects to enable scaling without quality loss and apply smart filters
Clipping mask discipline: Use clipping masks to isolate adjustments to single layers; prevents adjustment bleed
Mask over erase: Use layer masks instead of eraser tool for all visibility edits (enables undo/refinement)
Adjustment layer organization: Group related adjustment layers under the layer they target
Color grading hierarchy: Establish sky/light source color first; all other elements follow from dominant light color
Layer organization: Rename all layers on creation; group related layers; use color labels for visual scanning
Blending mode selection: Multiply removes white (darken), Screen removes black (lighten), Soft Light blends color into midtones
Non-destructive filter application: Use smart filters (Ctrl/Cmd+Click filter on smart objects) not direct filters
Opacity as refinement tool: Reduce layer opacity before adding new layers to dial in intensity
Selection method: Use Select Subject (cloud-detailed mode) before creating mask for AI-assisted accuracy
Perspective alignment: Scale/position/rotate subject first before blending; use smart guides (View > Snap) for alignment
Text layer conversion: Convert freeform text to paragraph text for bounding-box control in small areas
named_methods: Rotate Object feature - 3D-like rotation of background-removed subjects to match scene perspective; uses low-res proxy then restores quality on lock
Harmonize button - one-click lighting/shadow/color correction for composited subjects; offers 3 variations; pairs with adjustment layers for fine-tuning
Layer Cleanup AI - batch rename layers by content detection; optional empty layer deletion; uses AI to analyze layer contents
Dynamic Text feature - text that auto-scales to fill text frame while maintaining character size (no stretching); supports circle/arch/under-arch shapes
General Distractions removal - identifies poles, barriers, potholes, puddles, urban elements, spots/dust with color-coded selection; removes on non-destructive layer
Firefly 5 Image Model - newest generative fill model emphasizing detail retention and instructive prompts; better instruction-following than prior models
Partner Model Reference Image - can attach up to 8 reference images to generative fill when using Gemini/Flux/Banana models; prevents starting from scratch
Generative Credits Dashboard - shows remaining credits, renewal date, and per-feature credit cost before generation; accessible via upper right button or contextual menu
Reflection Removal - now available directly in Photoshop (not just Camera Raw); creates reflection layer, removal layer, original layer; enables opacity blending of reflection back
Firefly Boards - mood board system with Photoshop connection; save as cloud document, send to board, open in Photoshop, update on save; client-facing collaboration surface
Smart Filters - filters applied to smart objects that remain editable; paired with layer mask for selective application; compare to permanent filter application

Photo Composite Workflow - sky color baseline > blending mode application (multiply/screen/soft light) > adjustment layers (curves/color balance/hue saturation) > clipping masks > layer opacity refinement > smart filters for bloom/blur > manual brush highlights
Layer Mask Painting - white = fully visible, black = fully invisible, gray = partial transparency; enables infinite refinement vs permanent eraser
Clipping Mask Workflow - Alt/Option+Click layer or Right-Click > Create Clipping Mask to limit adjustment to single underlying layer
Color Grading Shadows/Highlights - shadows typically cold (cyan/magenta/blue), highlights typically warm (red/yellow/magenta) to create color contrast
Poster Design Layout - background layer > subject with mask > fill color background > text layers with effects > shape layers (gradients/patterns) > grouped organization throughout

specific_tactics: Background removal before color grading: Always mask background before applying adjustment layers to prevent color bleed
Proxy quality workflow: Use low-res for interactive positioning (rotation, scaling); high-res on lock to preserve original pixels
Three-variation selection: When harmonize offers 3 options, usually only 1 is usable; combine with adjustment layer for final dial-in
Smart guide alignment: Enable View > Snap and Smart Guides before positioning text/elements; watch for pink alignment lines
Adjustment layer stacking: Always place curves before color balance; curves for tone, color balance for hue/saturation shift
Layer effect duplication: Alt/Cmd+Drag effects thumbnail to other layer to copy drop shadow, stroke, glow etc.
Foreground/background color toggle: Set black for masking (invisible), white for unmasking (visible); press X to toggle
Selection brush cloud mode: Use cloud-detailed option for more accurate subject selection before masking
Generative fill prompt specificity: Include location, lighting, time of day, mood; vague prompts generate random results
Shade baking with soft light: Paint dark color on transparent layer with soft light blending to add shadow/depth without opacity reduction
Mask inversion: Ctrl/Cmd+I on white mask to invert to black (hides everything); then paint white to reveal selectively
Frequency separation workaround: Use adjustment layers with clipping masks instead of manual frequency separation for non-destructive skin refinement
Type as graphic element: Convert type to outline path (Type > Convert to Shape) to enable distortion/rotation without rasterization penalty
Blur edge painting: Use brush on smart filter mask with reduced opacity (30-50%) to feather blur at edges rather than hard cutoff

contradictions: Layer cleanup AI is presented as optional (can delete empty layers or not) but naming is automatic - partial automation precedent unclear
Harmonize button is fast (one-click) but often requires additional adjustment layers to dial in properly - expectation mismatch
Firefly 5 is described as 'do your thing' model (less specific prompts needed) but examples still use highly detailed prompts - specificity still required despite improvement
Rotate object uses 'temporary low res' but final output restores quality - unclear if this is true re-generation or interpolation
weird_gold: Harmonize tends to make images darker than expected; always have adjustment layer ready for brightness dial-in post-harmonize
When using screen blending mode, shadow cutoffs happen because selection was too small; make selections bigger than you think needed to give AI room for shadow/detail extension
Layer effect duplication (Alt+Drag effects) is faster than re-creating drop shadow on multiple text layers; underutilized efficiency move
Paragraph text conversion (Right-Click > Convert to Paragraph Text) unlocks bounding box control for text in confined spaces; separates text-tool flexibility from layout constraints
Soft light blending mode on dark colors creates believable shadow/depth (schools call it shade baking); beats manual shadow painting for natural look
Color balance shadows (cold: cyan/magenta/blue) contrasts with warm highlights (red/yellow/magenta) to create dynamic color depth in flat composites; counterintuitive but fundamental
Smart guides alignment (pink lines) are Context-driven (snap to edges, centers, midpoints); enable before text layout to auto-align without manual ruler work
Reflection removal creates 3 layers (removal, reflection, original) enabling opacity blending of reflection back in; useful for retaining subtle window/surface reflections at 20-30% opacity
Generative credits renewal visible in dashboard; hitting zero mid-project is friction point (no graceful degradation, just blocked)
Firefly Boards update button only appears after edit on cloud document; local PSD edits require manual save-as cloud before update works
